'''''Miss Theelin Live''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] used to advertise<ref name="Deception" /> a beauty pageant<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/deception-trivia-gallery|text="Deception" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}}</ref> known as [[Miss Theelin]]. It was [[color]]ed purple, orange, and gray and featured a [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] and [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text<ref name="Deception" /> which translated as:

<center><poem><big>MISS THEELIN LIVE</big>
<small>A PURPLE PEOPLE PARTY PRODUCTION</small>

COMING TO A [[The galaxy/Legends|GALAXY]] NEAR YOU
THIS [[Winter/Legends|WINTER]]<ref name="Trivia" /></poem></center>

The posters were put up in such locations as the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Trueping's/Legends|Trueping's]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Deception" /> aboard a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]]<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref> stolen by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]],<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref> and the town of [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora]] on the desolate planet [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Among the posters seen in the bar's back room where Hardeen sleeps is one for DJ Rangthang, one for Sy Snootles, a Felucian pin-up, and a travel poster for Pantora. In the corridor leading to the room is a poster for a 'Miss Theelin' beauty pageant. Illustrations by Randy Bantog.|Deception Trivia Gallery|<ref name="Trivia" />}}
The poster was illustrated by [[Randy Bantog]]<ref name="Trivia" /> and first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Deception]]."<ref name="Deception" />
